review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR and CS_ENGINE_IMAGE set); this report is derived from the recorded log plus a second record, target-writers.json, holding the engine image digest, the resolution and the limitations. MEASURED by static analysis of the owner-supplied decrypted executable (byte windows and a closed inventory of the 65 register-based [reg+0x70] stores pinned in the acceptance test): the launch 0x5aef40 has six direct callers and no other reference, none of which stores a target; the only writers of projectile +0x70/+0x74 are the launch zeroing (0x5af610), the removed-object sweep clear (0x5ac0f1) and the BEEPER_SEEKER callback 0x441780, installed into slot +0x688 by 0x441830 and run every step, which assigns and re-assigns the target from the beeper search 0x4b8b50; of the twelve guided records only wep_11 declares BEEPER_SEEKER. STILL UNMEASURED (none claimed): see the limitations array of target-writers.json - how the eleven other guided records obtain a target. The claim is implemented: this awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
